Load the LLM annotations
```{r}
library(tidyverse)
df <- read_csv("/Users/d.murray/Documents/science_criticism/data/raw/letter_llm_annotated_data.csv")
head(df)
```

First, lets process a version of the file that is mapped to letter IDs
```{r}
df_doi_only <- df %>%
  select(doi)

write_csv(df_doi_only, "/Users/d.murray/Documents/science_criticism/notebooks/annotations_doi_only.csv")


doi_links <- read_csv("/Users/d.murray/Documents/science_criticism/notebooks/annotation_doi_to_id.csv")
doi_links

agg_letters <- read_csv("/Users/d.murray/Documents/science_criticism/data/derived/agg/agg_letters.csv")

df_with_links <- df %>%
  left_join(doi_links, by = "doi") %>%
  left_join(agg_letters %>% select(letter_id, original_id), by = c("PaperId" = "letter_id")) %>%
  rename(letter_id = PaperId)

write_csv(df_with_links, "/Users/d.murray/Documents/science_criticism/data/raw/letter_llm_annotated_data.csv")
```

Show the values of validity and interest produced by the model
```{r}

df %>%
  filter(journal %in% c("Nature", "Science", "PNAS")) %>%
  mutate(
    Interest = ifelse(is_critical_bool == "No", "Low", Interest)
  ) %>%
  group_by(journal) %>%
  summarize(
    num = n(),
    num_valid = sum(is_critical_bool == "Yes"),
    prop_valid = round(sum(is_critical_bool == "Yes") / n() * 100, 2),
    num_interest = sum(Interest == "High"),
    prop_interest = round(sum(Interest == "High") / sum(is_critical_bool == "Yes") * 100, 2)
  )
```

Compare the manual annotations conducted previously against the LLM-based annotations used now
```{r}
library(readxl)
annotations <- read_excel("/Users/d.murray/Documents/science_criticism/data/raw/critical-letter_annotations.xlsx")


annotations %>%
  mutate(doi = tolower(gsub("https://doi.org/", "", doi, fixed = T))) %>%
  inner_join(df %>% mutate(doi = tolower(doi)) %>% select(doi, is_critical_bool), by = "doi") %>%
  group_by(journal) %>%
  summarize(
    num = n(),
    agreement = sum(is_valid & is_critical_bool == "Yes") 
  )

```


Construct a validation sample

```{r}
validation_sample <- df %>%
  filter(journal %in% c("Nature", "Science", "PNAS")) %>%
  group_by(journal) %>%
  sample_n(10) 


validation_sample

# write_csv(validation_sample, file = "~/...")

# for checking results
validation_sample_key <- validation_sample %>%
  left_join(df %>% select(doi, is_critical_bool, Interest), by = "doi")

write_csv(validation_sample_key, "/Users/d.murray/Documents/science_criticism/notebooks/validation_sample_key.csv")
```
